metadata.title: Fix Time-Series Period Extraction for Forecasting

story.iWant: the forecasting tool to correctly extract time-series data from ingested documents
story.soThat: I can generate revenue, expense, and cash flow forecasts for future quarters
story.tasks: - Task 1: Write SQL Migration Script (AC: 1) - Task 2: Implement SQL-Based Time-Series Extraction (AC: 2) - Task 3: Update MCP Tool for SQL-First Extraction (AC: 3) - Task 4: Unit Tests for New Functions (AC: 5) - Task 5: Integration Tests for End-to-End Flow (AC: 4) - Task 6: Run Migration on Production Database (AC: 1) - Task 7: UAT Re-Testing (AC: All) - Task 8: Documentation and Cleanup (AC: All)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
AC1: SQL Migration Backfills fiscal_year Column - GIVEN existing rows in `financial_tables` with `period` populated but `fiscal_year` NULL - WHEN the SQL migration script is executed - THEN `fiscal_year` is populated by parsing the year from `period` (e.g., "Jan-25" → 2025) - AND 300,000+ rows are updated (89% of 344,316 rows with period)
AC2: SQL-Based Time-Series Extraction Function - GIVEN the forecasting system needs historical metric data - WHEN `extract_timeseries_from_sql(metric="revenue")` is called - THEN it queries `financial_tables` for matching metric rows with valid `period` and `fiscal_year` - AND returns `TimeSeriesData` with properly dated values - AND falls back to hybrid search if SQL returns insufficient data (<8 points)
AC3: Forecasting Tool Uses SQL Extraction - GIVEN the SQL-based extraction is implemented - WHEN a user asks "What's the revenue forecast for the next quarter?" - THEN the `get_financial_forecast` tool: (1) Calls `extract_timeseries_from_sql()` first, (2) Falls back to `extract_timeseries()` if SQL fails, (3) Returns forecast values with dates, confidence intervals, methodology
AC4: Integration Test Validates End-to-End Flow - GIVEN the SQL migration has been applied - AND the SQL-based extraction is implemented - WHEN integration tests run - THEN `test_forecast_query_with_sql_extraction()` passes - AND forecast returns ≥8 data points for revenue metric
AC5: Unit Tests for Period Parsing - GIVEN the period parsing logic - WHEN unit tests are run - THEN all patterns are validated: parse_period_to_date("Jan-25") → datetime(2025, 1, 1), "Aug-24" → datetime(2024, 8, 1), "Dec-23" → datetime(2023, 12, 1)

doc.title: Epic 4 PRD - Forecasting & Proactive Insights
doc.snippet: Original time-series extraction requirements: Extract time-series financial data from documents for forecasting. Data points extracted with timestamps and metric labels. Extraction handles various date formats and fiscal period labels.

doc.title: Epic 4 PRD - Forecasting & Proactive Insights
doc.snippet: MCP tool `get_financial_forecast` with metric and time period parameters. Tool returns forecast values with confidence intervals. Explains basis for forecast (historical data used, methodology).

doc.title: High-Level Architecture
doc.snippet: Pattern: System continues operating with reduced capabilities if advanced features fail. Rationale: Reliability, user experience continuity. This story implements SQL-first extraction with fallback to hybrid search, following this pattern.

doc.title: RAGLite Coding Standards
doc.snippet: MANDATORY: All function signatures MUST include type hints. Google-style docstrings required for all public functions (Args, Returns, Raises). Raise specific exceptions with context. Structured logging with extra={} for all operations.

doc.title: Testing Strategy
doc.snippet: Unit tests: 80%+ coverage target, mock all external dependencies, fast execution. Integration tests: Use real PostgreSQL test database (APP_ENV=test, port 5433), test service integration, verify end-to-end workflows.

doc.title: Database Operation Modes
doc.snippet: TEST mode (ports 6335/5433): Tests MUST use APP_ENV=test, can delete test data. PRODUCTION mode (ports 6333/5432): Schema updates require deploy script with --force-data-loss flag. All operations use SafetyGuard class.

doc.title: Story 4.10 - Forecasting & Insights Test Suite
doc.snippet: Story 4.10 created validation framework with 87 tests (all PASS). Key patterns: Orchestrator pattern for E2E validation, reusable validators, SMAPE fallback for zero values. No new dependencies added (approved stack only). Files created: tests/validation/ (4 files), scripts/generate_validation_report.py.

Provides PostgreSQL database connection for SQL queries. Will be imported by new extract_timeseries_from_sql() function.

story-context.constraints:
1. **Database Safety (CRITICAL):** Story 4.0.7 established three-mode database operation system. SQL migration MUST use production deploy mode with --force-data-loss flag. All database operations must use SafetyGuard from raglite/shared/safety.py. Integration tests MUST use APP_ENV=test and will FAIL if they detect production ports (6333/5432).
2. **Graceful Degradation Pattern:** New SQL-first extraction follows high-level architecture graceful degradation pattern. Try SQL extraction → if fails → fall back to hybrid search. Maintains backward compatibility and reliability.
3. **Type Hints MANDATORY:** All function signatures MUST include type hints for parameters and return values per coding-standards.md.
4. **Google-Style Docstrings MANDATORY:** All public functions require Google-style docstrings with Args, Returns, Raises, Example sections per coding-standards.md.
5. **Structured Logging:** All operations must use structured logging with extra={} context (metric name, row counts, date ranges, errors).
6. **Error Handling:** Raise specific exceptions with context (ExtractionError with insufficient data message). Handle SQL connection errors gracefully. Log errors before raising.
7. **No New Dependencies:** Epic 4 pattern - use only approved libraries in tech stack. PostgreSQL driver (psycopg2-binary) already approved in Story 2.6.
8. **Testing Coverage:** Unit tests target ≥80% coverage. Integration tests use real PostgreSQL test database. UAT re-testing validates all Epic 4 forecasting queries.
9. **SQL Query Patterns:** Use LIKE pattern matching for metric names (LOWER(metric) LIKE '%revenue%'). Filter WHERE period IS NOT NULL AND fiscal_year IS NOT NULL. Order chronologically: ORDER BY fiscal_year, period.
10. **Repository Structure:** Estimated ~500 new lines total (SQL migration ~30 lines, extraction function ~150 lines, tests ~250 lines, MCP update ~20 lines). Well within MVP scope.

interface.name: extract_timeseries_from_sql()
interface.signature: async def extract_timeseries_from_sql(metric: str = "revenue", min_points: int = 8) -> TimeSeriesData
interface.description: NEW function to create. Primary extraction method for forecasting. Queries PostgreSQL financial_tables for metric with period and fiscal_year. Returns TimeSeriesData with dated values. Raises ExtractionError if insufficient data.

interface.name: parse_period_to_date()
interface.signature: def parse_period_to_date(period: str, fiscal_year: int) -> datetime
interface.description: NEW helper function to create. Converts period string (e.g., "Jan-25") to datetime. Handles all months (Jan-Dec). Returns datetime for first day of period month.

interface.name: get_financial_forecast()
interface.signature: @mcp.tool() async def get_financial_forecast(metric: str, periods_ahead: int = 4) -> str
interface.description: EXISTING MCP tool to modify. Currently calls extract_timeseries(). Needs update to call extract_timeseries_from_sql() first with fallback to hybrid search on ExtractionError.

interface.name: financial_tables schema
interface.signature: CREATE TABLE financial_tables (metric VARCHAR(500), value NUMERIC, period VARCHAR(500), fiscal_year INTEGER, ...)
interface.description: EXISTING table from Story 2.6. Contains 386,466 rows with metric/value pairs. period column is 89% populated (e.g., "Jan-25"). fiscal_year column needs backfill (currently 3.6% populated).

interface.name: TimeSeriesData model
interface.signature: class TimeSeriesData(BaseModel): metric_name: str, points: List[TimeSeriesPoint], interval: str, source_documents: List[str]
interface.description: EXISTING model. Return type for extract_timeseries_from_sql(). Contains list of TimeSeriesPoint objects with date, value, label.

interface.name: SafetyGuard
interface.signature: class SafetyGuard: validate_test_environment(context: str), check_production_port(port: int)
interface.description: EXISTING safety class from Story 4.0.7. Integration tests MUST use SafetyGuard.validate_test_environment() to prevent accidental production database access.

tests.standards: Use pytest with pytest-asyncio for async tests. Mock external dependencies (PostgreSQL, Qdrant) in unit tests. Use real PostgreSQL test database (APP_ENV=test, port 5433) for integration tests. Target ≥80% coverage on new functions. Parametrize tests for all month patterns (Jan-Dec). Use Google-style docstrings in test functions. Follow testing-strategy.md patterns from Story 4.10 validation framework.
tests.ideas: AC1: test_sql_migration_regex_pattern() - Verify regex extracts 2-digit year correctly AC1: test_sql_migration_edge_cases() - Test invalid formats, NULL values, no data loss AC2: test_extract_timeseries_from_sql_revenue() - Mock SQL connection, return valid TimeSeriesData AC2: test_extract_timeseries_from_sql_insufficient_data() - Raise ExtractionError if <8 points AC2: test_parse_period_to_date_all_months() - Parametrize test for Jan-25, Feb-25, ..., Dec-25 AC2: test_parse_period_to_date_edge_cases() - Invalid format, case insensitivity, fallback AC3: test_forecast_tool_uses_sql_extraction() - Integration test with real database AC3: test_forecast_tool_fallback_to_hybrid() - SQL fails, verify hybrid search called AC4: test_forecast_query_with_sql_extraction() - End-to-end MCP tool test with ≥8 data points AC4: test_sql_extraction_finds_revenue_data() - Real database query returns valid data AC5: test_period_parsing_correctness() - Verify month number and year parsed correctly General: test_safety_guard_validates_test_environment() - SafetyGuard prevents production access
